heroHeadline: Kim Jong-un Tests AI-Guided Tactical Cruise Missiles — DPRK's 8th Weapons Test of 2026; Jongju SRBMs Fired Two Days Earlier
heroSubtitle: Kim Jong-un personally supervised tests of North Korea's first publicly claimed AI-guided tactical cruise missiles on May 27, 2026 — the DPRK's eighth weapons test of the year — featuring AI-based terminal homing guidance, TERCOM navigation, and a new lightweight multipurpose missile launcher for frontline deployment. The tests followed SRBM and multiple rocket launcher launches from Jongju toward the Yellow Sea on May 25, South Korea's first confirmed provocation since April. The weapons burst came just days after North Korea's Naegohyang Women's FC made history winning the AFC Women's Champions League on South Korean soil (May 23), highlighting Pyongyang's simultaneous use of limited inter-Korean sporting engagement and military signaling. Pro-Pyongyang Chongryon in Japan removed reunification from its charter on May 22, extending Kim's ideological reorientation through DPRK's overseas diaspora networks.
footerNote: Data sourced from US/ROK official reports, KCNA, UN panels, IAEA, and institutional analyses. North Korea does not publish national statistics — economic figures are estimates with wide uncertainty ranges.
